info.name: UnSmoked - AI Quota
info.description:
AI Coach quota management endpoints for the UnSmoke'm app.

Set the `base_url` and `token` variables before testing.

variable.description: The user's MongoDB _id used as RevenueCat app_user_id
Store transaction ID from reload purchase receipt

request.description:
Check the user's AI quota status.

**Expected before subscription:** `hasQuota: false`

**Expected after subscription:** full quota object with `allowanceEur`, `usedEur`, `remainingEur`, etc.

response.name: No Quota (Not Subscribed)

item.name: 2. Send AI Message (Before Subscribe - Should Fail)

request.description:
Try sending an AI message without an active quota.

**Expected:** `403` with code `NO_AI_QUOTA`

response.name: Blocked - No Quota

request.description:
Call this AFTER the mobile app confirms a premium subscription purchase via RevenueCat.

Set the `revenueCatUserId` variable to the user's MongoDB `_id`.

**Expected:** `200` with quota initialized at €1.50 allowance.

response.name: No Active Subscription

request.description:
Verify quota was created successfully.

**Expected:** `hasQuota: true`, `allowanceEur: 1.5`, `usedEur: 0`

item.name: 5. Send AI Message (With Quota - Should Work)

request.description:
Send an AI message with active quota.

**Expected:** `200` with AI response. Quota `usedEur` increases based on actual OpenAI token cost.

response.name: AI Response Success

request.description:
Check that `usedEur` increased after sending messages.

**Expected:** `usedEur` > 0, `remainingEur` < 1.50

item.name: 7. Send AI Message (Quota Exceeded - Should Fail)

request.description:
Try sending when quota is fully used up.

**Expected:** `403` with code `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` and remaining quota info.

response.name: Blocked - Quota Exceeded

request.description:
Call this AFTER the mobile app confirms a reload pack purchase (€3.99) via RevenueCat.

Set the `transactionId` variable to the store transaction ID from the purchase receipt.

**Expected:** `200`, allowance increases by €1.50.

response.name: Reload Applied
Duplicate Transaction
Purchase Not Found

request.description:
Try applying the same reload transaction again.

**Expected:** `409` with code `DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION`

item.name: 10. Send AI Message (After Reload - Should Work)

request.description:
After reload, sending messages should work again.

**Expected:** `200` with AI response.

Final check showing all quota details including reload count.

**Expected:** `reloadCount: 1`, updated `usedEur` and `remainingEur`.
